figures.caption: Tē 43 tô.—Ūi-ėk-chôaⁿ: Chit ê tô sī beh chí-bêng ūi-ėk-chôaⁿ kap mñg-sòe-huih-kńg ū chhin-ji̍t ê kan-sia̍p. V, chēng-me̍h-kńg; A, tōng-me̍h-kńg ; 1, Ūi ê lāi-bīn ; 2 ūi-ėk-chôaⁿ-kńg ; 3 ūi-ėk-chôaⁿ ê sòe-pau teh hun-pì sng-sèng ê ūi-ėk. (From Lewis' “Anatomy and Physiology for Nurses.”)
Tē 44 tô.—Chit ê tô sī chhin-chhiūⁿ tē 42, chòng-sī tī chia ū ūi-līm-pa-kńg (L) ; 2, ūi-ėk-chôaⁿ-kńg.
